pin.capture: Pinned upstream watch-pr modules, Bun 1.3.6, Commander 14.0.0. Only run(argv) in the owned scratch copy is instrumented to return scripted process results. The stdout capture uses Buffer UTF8 encoding, as the real CLI does. All parsing, queries, decisions, queue transitions and rendering run upstream code with a deterministic clock. Expected values are emitted by upstream, not Python.

selection.runtime: Retains verdict/readiness precedence, retry/reset/deadline modes, every queue transition scenario, fallback/schema errors, pagination and rendering. Removes standalone draft/recovery and thread-page variants covered by longer traces. URL rules shared by origin/current-PR inference use representative spellings rather than repeating the same normalization on both paths.
selection.pure: Retains merge refusal/allowance boundaries, check/gate mapping, schema-error precedence, Bugbot attribution and stack ordering. Removes check-name/state Cartesian products, equivalent missing-state/keyless forms and simpler schema errors covered by multiple-invalid-field cases.
selection.parsing: Retains each numeric syntax and validation boundary once, with zero/fraction boundaries for each option family. Retains Commander value consumption, help/error ordering, queue validation and option syntax. Removes the repeated numeric-token matrix across flags and equivalent malformed-option spellings.
selection.storage: runtimeDefaults supplies only omitted top-level runtime fields; a sole $ref copies an exact named shared value. Shared values are frozen upstream data, not recomputed watcher results. Retained observations expand losslessly.
